en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a broad, tree‑lined street with late‑19th‑century multi‑storey buildings on the left and right. The left side features an ornate stone building with classical details, likely a post office or official building, while large leafy trees line the right side of the street. A few pedestrians are visible in the distance. Red printed German text appears at the top of the image.
